name: Clown Squad
source:
Heroes — everyone knows the word, and almost everyone, at least once, dreamed of becoming one.
Some wanted to save people, some longed for fame, and some… just wanted to prove they were worth something.

This is a story about a man who had that dream, to stand among the heroes.

But fate played a cruel trick on him, gifting him the most useless and self-defeating ability imaginable.
A clown who can’t lie. Can you even call that a power? A rhetorical question.

In a world where a flying man is nothing special anymore and people who can lift houses with one hand are practically commonplace,  a clown looks ridiculous beside them.

And yet… maybe he wasn’t born with strength or fire or lightning.
But he had something else: hard work, stubbornness, and a sharp mind.

And now, you are about to witness the story of a clown who challenged the entire world — trying to prove that his fate belongs to him and no one else.

[From [url=https://noglory.itch.io/clown-squad]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
英雄——每个人都知道这个词，几乎每个人都至少曾经梦想成为一名英雄。
有的人想救人，有的人渴望名誉，有的人……只是想证明自己有价值。

这是一个关于一个男人的故事，他怀揣着成为英雄的梦想。

但命运却对他开了一个残酷的玩笑，赋予了他最无用、最弄巧成拙的能力。
一个不会说谎的小丑。你能称之为力量吗？一个反问句。

在一个飞人已不是什么特别的世界，能用一只手举起房子的人几乎是司空见惯的世界里，小丑在他们身边显得很可笑。

然而……也许他生来就没有力量、火焰或闪电。
但他还有另外一些东西：勤奋、固执和敏锐的头脑。

现在，你将见证一个小丑挑战整个世界的故事——试图证明他的命运属于他而不是别人。
